This document outlines the maintenance inspection I1, which must be performed 
on yearly bases or every six months as indicated in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Kamal Oshba, tested by eng. Reda 
Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, approved by eng. 
Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia: WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.

A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.

Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area must be used.

Wear safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, masks.

Before start cleaning 
 wear breathing mask to protect lung tissues from dust particles and chemical 
 solvent which if exist, expose lungs to danger.

Don't throw any 
 cleaning liquid on ground, collect it and send to dumb.

Don't burn clothes used 
 in cleaning collect it and send to dumb.
Suitable tool set.
Safety helmet safety shoes and masks.
Vacuum cleaner or blower.
Pieces of soft clothes and cleaning liquid.

Switch off the 
transformer which feeds the bus bar and isolate the bus bar from the two sides.

Switch off all feeders 
at the bus bar and switch on their earthing switches.

Insure that all 3 phases 
of each feeder at that busbar don`t pass a current through it before draw the 
circuit breaker`s out of the busbar.
Switch off DC source.

Draw circuit breakers 
out of bus bar.

Connect B.B earthing 
device.

Dismantle upper and 
lower shutters.

Blow the dust abd dirt 
out of bus bar (using vacuum cleaner).

Clean the upper contact 
(related to bus bar) and lower contact (related to cables).

Check current 
transformers to be well fixed retighten bolts and screws and clean it.

Retighten bolts and 
screws for bus bar parts.

Check and clean 
potential transformer and its cell and clean.

Check the heaters 
in the cells to be switched on clean it put the indicator of each heater at the 
suitable position.

Check earthing switch of 
each feeder cell to be in good contact (as it switched on) check also that it 
moves is easily.

Check cells to be well 
sealed and no way for rats to get into the cells.

Clean the upper parts of 
cells and the instruments involved in it such as protection apparatus timers 
measuring instruments etc.

Clean shutters well and 
put it in its places in the cells.

Clean the passages that 
tracks across it in and out the cells so breaker could get in and out of cells 
easily.

Switch off earthing 
switches for all feeders cells.

Disconnect the B.B 
earthing device.

Put breakers in test 
position switch on and off the breakers electrically and then put them into 
their cells.
